CommunityApplications.Profile:
This repository publishes a Community Applications template for **SuperSync**, an unofficial, publicly-rebuilt Docker image of [Super Productivity](https://super-productivity.com)'s own sync backend server.
Upstream (`super-productivity/super-productivity`) only ships this server as a **private** GHCR image, so this repo rebuilds it unmodified from their public source (`packages/super-sync-server`) and pushes it to Docker Hub at `webstas/supersync`, tracking the `master` branch daily.
For support, please open an issue on the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/BigWebstas/SuperSync/issues).
